lens.zh-CN: 没有策略选择，也会期待结果

edition.zh-CN: 规则家族 · 比较三种终点处理
edition.en: A family of rules · Three finish conditions

comparison.zh-CN: 同样是随机前进，超过终点可以不动、折返，也可以直接到达。先把具体版本说清，才能判断尾段为何拖延，或为什么突然结束。
comparison.en: A random advance can leave an overshooting pawn still, send it backward, or let it finish. Identify the edition before explaining the ending.

boundary.zh-CN: Hasbro 32930 用转盘且超出不动；Orchard 629 用骰子、不要求精确点数；Traditional Garden Games 012 用骰子、超出折返。课程的 24 格棋盘是另行编写的教学版本。
boundary.en: Hasbro 32930 uses a spinner, an exact finish, and no movement on an overshoot; Orchard 629 uses a die without requiring an exact finish; Traditional Garden Games 012 uses a die and bounces back on overshoots. Our 24-space board is an authored teaching variant.

label.zh-CN: Hasbro《滑梯与梯子》芝麻街版规则
label.en: Hasbro Chutes and Ladders: Sesame Street rules
Orchard Jungle Snakes and Ladders rules

label.zh-CN: Traditional Garden Games 蛇梯棋规则

lens.en: Arrange the outcome after the roll

edition.zh-CN: 中文名暂译 · 经典棋盘版 4416

comparison.zh-CN: 六枚色骰给出这一回合可用的颜色，玩家再安排使用顺序和路线。点数大小不再是唯一问题：可用的骰子怎样接成合法前进？
comparison.en: Six color dice provide the available colors; players arrange their order and route. The question becomes how the rolled resources connect into legal movement.

boundary.zh-CN: 规则要求尽可能前进，不能任意提前停步。换道与占格有专门限制；有人到达后完成整轮。这里不采用新版拼接赛道的组件或规则。
boundary.en: The rules require advancing as far as possible, with specific lane and occupancy restrictions. Complete the round after a car arrives. This is not the newer modular-track edition.

label.zh-CN: HABA 经典版官方规则（英文印刷页 7–9）

comparison.zh-CN: 骰子可以组合成不同的和，玩家还要决定继续掷还是结束回合。先前推进是否已经保住，会改变下一次冒险的代价。
comparison.en: Dice can be paired into different sums, and players decide whether to roll again or end the turn. Whether progress is secure changes the cost of the next risk.

boundary.zh-CN: 不要把临时推进说成已经永久占有，也不要把四骰配对的和当作等概率结果。规则与列长的完整关系见已有案例。
boundary.en: Temporary progress is not permanent ownership, and sums from four-dice pairings are not equally likely. The full case examines the rules and column lengths together.

lens.zh-CN: 在比赛的，不一定是你的棋子
lens.en: The racers need not belong to you

edition.zh-CN: 第二版 · Lookout 2024 重印规则

comparison.zh-CN: 玩家没有自己的参赛骆驼，而是通过下注等行动争取更多金钱。关注赛道位置，可能是为了重新判断谁会领先，而不是让自己那一只前进。
comparison.en: Players do not own racing camels; they use bets and other actions to earn money. Track positions matter as evidence about likely leaders, rather than simply as personal progress.

boundary.zh-CN: 第二版加入反向行进的骆驼，通常完整赛段从六枚骰子中揭示五枚；越过终点会立即进入终局，末赛段可能提前结束。不能直接套用第一版的骰子数量。
boundary.en: The second edition includes backward-moving camels. A normal complete leg reveals five of six dice; crossing the finish ends the game immediately, so the final leg may end sooner. Do not import the first edition’s dice count.

lens.zh-CN: 共享赛道，关注不同结果

comparison.zh-CN: 六只蜗牛都参加，两枚色骰推动对应蜗牛。玩家预测谁最先、谁最后到达，提醒我们分开看“谁在移动”和“玩家为什么关心”。
comparison.en: All six snails race, moved by two color dice. Players predict the first and last finishers, separating the pieces that move from the reasons people care.

boundary.zh-CN: 这里指 20629《蜗牛赛跑》，不是另一产品号的版本。预测时点在各语言文本中详略不同；法文明确所有蜗牛至少动过一次后再猜。
boundary.en: This is Snail’s Race 20629. Language editions vary in how explicitly they state prediction timing; the French text specifies after every snail has moved at least once.
